en: The image shows the address side of an old postcard labeled "BRIEFKAART" in green print. It has a handwritten address in dark ink, including a name and a Madrid address, with a word that looks like "Granzi" written at the top left. In the upper‑right corner there is a red postage stamp from the Netherlands, cancelled with a circular postmark reading "UTRECHT" and a date in June. The card has an aged, yellowed appearance and no photograph or illustration is visible.
